items.html: And let us begin to explain from the Shema upon the bed, for it is the lowest level of them all. For behold, at night, certainly all the Mochin do not depart, as mentioned, and necessarily the inner Mochin from the side of Ima remain. And when we read the Shema upon the bed, it is found that before we said the Shema, behold, there were in ZA only the inner Mochin of Ima alone. Therefore when we say "Israel," in order to draw him an illumination from above, so that he will be able afterwards to raise Mayin Nukvin, in order to also receive the Mochin of Gadlut — behold, then he cannot draw a great illumination, but only one level more than he had at first. And it is that at first he had the inner Mochin of the Katnut of Ima, and now, in the word "Israel," the illumination added to him now is the encircling ones of the Katnut of Ima. And it is found that when he raises Mayin Nukvin in the word "Echad," as is known, behold, he still has only up to the level of the encircling ones of Ima, and the inner and encircling ones of Aba of Katnut are missing from him; and this is the amount of the levels that were already in him in the word "Israel" in the Shema of the morning.
